units.source_text: 薰大将辞别明石皇后出来，想去望望那天晚上曾入其室的小宰相君，并且看看前天窥探过的那间廊房，借以慰情。

en.t: After taking leave of Empress Akashi, General Kaoru came out and thought he would visit Kozaisho no Kimi, whose room he had entered that night, and also look at the corridor room he had peeped into the day before, hoping to comfort his feelings.

units.source_text: 便穿过正殿，走向大公主所居的西殿去。

en.t: He then passed through the main hall and went toward the western wing where the elder princess lived.

units.source_text: 这里帘内的侍女戒备特别森严。

en.t: Here, the ladies-in-waiting behind the curtains kept especially strict watch.

units.source_text: 薰大将相貌堂堂，威风凛凛地走近廊前，但见夕雾左大臣家诸公子正在那里和侍女们谈话，便在边门面前坐下，说道：

en.t: General Kaoru, handsome and commanding in bearing, approached the front of the corridor, but when he saw the young gentlemen of Left Minister Yugiri's household talking there with the ladies-in-waiting, he sat down before a side door and said,

units.source_text: “我经常到这一带地方来，却难得和各位见面。

en.t: "I often come around this area, yet I seldom have the chance to meet all of you.

units.source_text: 真想不到，似觉自己已经变成了老翁，今后非下决心多来亲近亲近不可。

en.t: It is unexpected, but I feel as if I have already become an old man; from now on I must make up my mind to come more often and grow closer to you.

units.source_text: 你们这些年轻人看了会说我不相称吧？”

en.t: You young people will see me doing that and say it does not suit me, won't you?"
As he said this, he looked over at several of his nephews.

units.source_text: 有一个侍女说道：“从今练习起来，定会返老还童。”

en.t: One lady-in-waiting said, "If you begin practicing from now on, you will surely grow young again."

units.source_text: 这里的人随随便便说一两句话也有风趣，可见这殿内非常优雅，富于情味。

en.t: Even a casual word or two from the people here had charm, showing how very elegant and full of feeling the residence was.

units.source_text: 他来这里并无事情，但和侍女们说说闲话，觉得非常舒服，因此坐得特别长久。

en.t: He had no particular business in coming here, but chatting idly with the ladies-in-waiting felt very pleasant, so he remained seated for an especially long time.
